[13:27:14 (11s)] I do not push myself. This session runs as the PR Dashboard app's PR agent, and its rule is never to push: the app pushes the commits right after the session, once it has checked that they fast-forward the branch `feature/X-1`.

**What goes out:** 4 commits on top of [aaaaaaa0001](https://example.com/org/repo/commit/aaaaaaa0001):
- [bbbbbbb0002](https://example.com/org/repo/commit/bbbbbbb0002) — the `FooService` service and the panels moved onto it;
- [ccccccc0003](https://example.com/org/repo/commit/ccccccc0003) — undo/redo docs;
- [ddddddd0004](https://example.com/org/repo/commit/ddddddd0004) — a gallery with no entity no longer starts the cleanup;
- [eeeeeee0005](https://example.com/org/repo/commit/eeeeeee0005) — cleanup specs for gallery and dashboards.

The app posts the replies to reviewer's two threads after the push, once you press Publish.

⚠️ **Checks before push that did not run here:**
- No fresh `git fetch`: git in this session has no network.
- Build, type check, lint and Jest not run: no `node_modules`.
- Only the syntax and unused imports of the changed files were checked.

So CI is the first real run.
